steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Mealie at http://127.0.0.1:8102/ using email admin@bench.local and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify signed-in state and report what confirms it.
02-report: Report the exact names of all recipes whose names start with Seed: as shown in Mealie, without modifying any recipes.

03-create: Create and save a new Mealie recipe named '{{runid}} Bench Recipe' with a description that includes the exact runid {{runid}}. Do not alter any Seed recipes. Verify the saved recipe exists with its name and description.

04-edit: Edit the existing recipe '{{runid}} Bench Recipe' so its only category is the existing category 'Bench Dinner' and its only tag is the existing tag 'Bench Quick'. Choose the existing suggestions rather than creating similar entries. Save the editor, then verify the recipe page shows exactly that category and tag with no others.

05-edit: Edit and save '{{runid}} Bench Recipe' with exactly two ingredients in order, both with no note: amount 2, existing unit Bench Cup, existing food Bench Flour; then amount 3, existing unit Bench Spoon, existing food Bench Butter. Remove any placeholder or extra ingredients. Its instructions must be exactly two steps in order: 'Whisk the flour and butter.' and 'Bake until golden ({{runid}}).' Remove any placeholder or extra steps. Choose existing unit and food suggestions rather than creating new entries. Verify the saved recipe shows precisely these ingredients and steps.
06-set: Set the servings for '{{runid}} Bench Recipe' to exactly 4 in the recipe editor, save, and verify the saved recipe page displays 4 servings.

07-verify: Post exactly one comment on the page for '{{runid}} Bench Recipe'. The comment text must include the exact runid {{runid}}. Use the comment's own submit button (not the recipe editor Save), then verify the page shows exactly one comment and report its exact text.
